referralText:
Dear Dr. Chow,

Re: Morgan Tse, 41

Thank you for seeing this 41-year-old logistics supervisor with an 8-month history of low mood, poor sleep and reduced concentration following a restructuring at work. She has been off work on medical leave since October 27. Sertraline started in April, increased to 150 mg six weeks ago with partial benefit. PHQ-9 in my office 18. She drinks alcohol most evenings. No known medical conditions. BP 142/90 at last visit. Please assess and advise on management and return-to-work planning.

Thank you,
Dr. A. Patel, Family Physician
medsText:
Sertraline 150 mg PO daily (increased from 100 mg on Oct 8)
Zopiclone 7.5 mg PO at bedtime as needed
Ibuprofen 400 mg PO as needed
No known drug allergies

about.children: Son 12, daughter 9, both live with us

concerns.main: Since around March I've felt flat and low most days. Work did a big restructure, I got a bigger team with fewer people and couldn't keep up. I stopped sleeping properly and my doctor put me off work.
concerns.trigger: Restructuring at work in March. My manager left and I took on her team.
concerns.impact: Off work since end of October. I stopped coaching my son's soccer team. I'm on the couch most of the day and short with the kids.
concerns.tried: Sertraline since April, dose went up in October, maybe a bit better. Saw a work counsellor twice.

psych.careDetail: EAP counsellor twice this spring, stopped going.

medical.conditionsOther: My husband says I snore loudly and sometimes I wake up choking.

family.famDetail: Dad drank heavily. Mom had depression, never treated.

social.childhood: Fairly stable. Dad's drinking made things tense at home in my teens.
social.occupation: Shipping supervisor at a distribution centre, 30 staff
social.leave: Since October 27, medical leave for depression
social.work: Bigger team with fewer people after the restructure. I dread the morning huddle and can't make decisions.
social.support: My husband. I haven't told my friends.

goals.hopes: Feel like myself again and work out if and when I can go back to work. Maybe try a different medication.
goals.questions: Is it safe to keep drinking while on sertraline?

risk.summary: C-SSRS screener: Low risk: ideation without method, intent or plan.
